==Notes==
* This skill requires exactly 160 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 6 strikes and 10 units.
*This skill works very well with [[Sundering Weapon]], as the Cracked Armor from the weapon spell will apply first, thus applying the Deep Wound. 
* The skill also works well with [[Mark of Fury]], as the hex helps build adrenaline and applies [[Cracked Armor]].

==Trivia==
*The warrior in the [[skill icon]] is wearing [[Warrior Elite Charr Hide armor|Elite Charr Hide armor]]. The other figure is a female monk wearing [[Monk Flowing armor|Flowing armor]].
